title: A Aftermath for the Language
author: Felix Coldharbour
blurb: Isandro Okafor, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
